g.text: unreadable ones become DS100 errors from the engine and
are never passed to any analyzer. Skips the evaluated
DS116 owns unsafe targets (escape, drive, UNC,
DOCSENTINEL_USE_EXTERNAL_API=1) AND the backend API key variable
AND a loadable backend. Closed gate: one WARNING and a pending
entry, nothing imported or sent. extract-facts calls the same
trace_candidates offline: no gate, no backend, no network.
No edge points from mining/ or fact_check/ up into detectors/,
Heuristic candidates only; exit code stays 0.
